model: Single uniform-temperature pouch-cell equivalent exposed to a prescribed ambient loss
provenance: Illustrative independent teaching assumptions; not Apple or Wisk cell data
scope: 0D average temperature; all six faces have the same effective heat-loss coefficient; constant properties; no enclosure, electrochemistry, charging controller, or spatial temperature field
loss_coefficient_basis: Uncalibrated combined effective surface loss. Radiation is not added separately. This coefficient is not a validated phone boundary condition.
heat_source_basis: Prescribed thermal heat generation. 1 W is neither charging input power nor a measured battery loss.
